# Home Loan Essentials

> Home Loan Essentials is a mortgage broking business run by Jack Perkins, based in Helensvale on the Gold Coast, Queensland, and serving clients across Australia. Jack compares home loans from a panel of 30+ banks, credit unions and non-bank lenders. There is no broker fee to the client; brokers are usually paid by the lender.

- Phone: 0478 938 981
- Email: jack@homeloanessentials.com.au
- Location: Helensvale, Gold Coast QLD. Works with clients in every state and territory, in person or online.
- All content on this site is general information only, not personal credit or financial advice.

## Home Loans

- [Buying a Home](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/buying-a-home.html): Buying your next home on the Gold Coast or anywhere in Australia? Jack Perkins compares 30+ lenders, sorts pre-approval and stays with you to settlement.
- [Becoming a First Home Buyer](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/first-home-buyers.html): First home buyer in Queensland or anywhere in Australia? Jack explains the 5% Deposit Scheme, the QLD First Home Owner Grant and stamp duty concessions, and finds the right loan.
- [Building a New Home](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/building-a-new-home.html): Building a new home or a house and land package? Jack Perkins arranges construction loans with progress payments and keeps your builder, lender and solicitor on the same page.
- [Refinancing](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/refinancing.html): Paying too much on your home loan? Jack Perkins checks the market across 30+ lenders and tells you plainly whether refinancing will save you money.
- [Investing in Property](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/investing-in-property.html): Buying an investment property? Jack Perkins helps you structure the loan properly from day one, using equity, interest-only and split loans where they make sense.

## Business Loans

- [Asset & Equipment Finance](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/asset-equipment-finance.html): Finance for vehicles, machinery and equipment for your business. Jack Perkins can help directly or refer you to a trusted asset finance specialist.
- [Business Finance](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/business-finance.html): Business loans, overdrafts and working capital for small businesses. Jack Perkins helps directly or refers you to a trusted business finance specialist.
- [Commercial Property Finance](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/commercial-property-finance.html): Finance for offices, shops, warehouses and other commercial property. Jack Perkins helps directly or refers you to a trusted commercial finance specialist.

## Specialist Lending

- [Self-Employed & Low Doc Loans](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/self-employed-low-doc-loans.html): Self-employed and finding it hard to get a home loan? Jack Perkins knows which lenders understand business income, including low doc options.
- [Foreign Investment Finance](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/foreign-investment-finance.html): Home loans for foreign buyers, non-residents and temporary visa holders buying in Australia. General information on FIRB, surcharges and lender requirements.
- [Professional Packages](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/professional-packages.html): Doctors, lawyers, accountants and other eligible professionals may be able to buy with a smaller deposit and reduced or waived LMI. Jack checks which lenders offer it.
- [Debt Consolidation](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/debt-consolidation.html): Rolling credit cards, car loans and personal loans into your home loan can lower repayments. Jack Perkins explains the trade-offs so you can decide.
- [Construction & Land Loans](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/construction-land-loans.html): Loans to buy vacant land now and build later, owner-builder and investment construction. Jack Perkins explains lender requirements and finds the right fit.
- [SMSF Loans](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/services/smsf-loans.html): Borrowing to buy property in a self-managed super fund. General information on limited recourse borrowing arrangements and what lenders require.

## Calculators

- [Borrowing Power](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/borrowing-power.html): Estimate how much you could borrow for a home loan in Australia. Includes a 3% serviceability buffer, living expense floor and credit card limits. Indicative only.
- [Loan Repayments](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/loan-repayments.html): Work out weekly, fortnightly or monthly home loan repayments, principal and interest or interest only, and the total interest you would pay.
- [Amortisation Schedule](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/amortisation.html): See how your home loan balance falls year by year, how much goes to principal and interest, and how extra repayments cut time and interest.
- [Rent vs Buy](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/rent-vs-buy.html): Compare the total cost of renting against buying over the years ahead, including rent increases, property growth, stamp duty, ongoing costs and the opportunity cost of your deposit.
- [Dead Money](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/dead-money.html): How much of what you pay over the next few years is money you never see again? Compare rent with mortgage interest and ownership costs.
- [Stamp Duty](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/stamp-duty.html): Estimate stamp duty (transfer duty) in Queensland and other states, with first home buyer and home concessions, owner-occupier or investor, and foreign buyer surcharges.
- [Lenders Mortgage Insurance](https://www.homeloanessentials.com.au/calculators/lmi.html): Get an indicative estimate of Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI) based on your loan amount and LVR. LMI varies by lender and insurer.
